output.reason: [ev-85eccdc718e3] and [ev-2941a875a468] say the istio-base chart now templates the CRDs, so `helm upgrade istio-base` can upgrade them, and that the CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources. Both also say operators who installed or upgraded CRDs with `kubectl apply` can keep doing so. [ev-fa194382072a] adds that templating is now on by default and that `base.enableCRDTemplates=false` brings back the old behaviour. None of this says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so the right consequence is a low-severity behavior-change that needs review, not mandatory work.
